name: Z.AI Free Flash Models
allowance: Free API models; current public pricing does not publish a fixed daily-token allowance
notes: GLM-4.7-Flash and GLM-4.5-Flash are currently free text models; GLM-4.6V-Flash is a currently free vision model.
Do not infer a fixed TPD quota from model pricing; provider limits may vary independently.

name: LLM7.io Free Token Access
privacy: anonymous usage data may be used to improve future models; token-account email and minimal metadata are retained as needed for access, rate limits, and abuse prevention
models_or_scope: 11 models in the current catalog; model availability and limits can change
allowance: 1,000,000 tokens/day, 250 requests/hour, 60 requests/minute, 2 requests/second for free-token access
notes: Anonymous access is lower: 500,000 tokens/day, 60 requests/hour, 10 requests/minute, 1 request/second.
Function calling is advertised as a Pro feature, so the recurring free-token entry does not claim tool-calling support.
Default privacy policy should exclude this route unless data-improvement use is explicitly allowed.

name: Aion Labs Free Tier
privacy: user content and API requests are processed under Aion Labs and upstream provider terms
models_or_scope: Aion 2.0, Aion 2.5, Aion 3.0, Aion 3.0 Mini, Aion-RP 1.0; current catalog is text-to-text
allowance: 15 requests/minute, 20,000 tokens/minute, 20,000 tokens/day on the Free tier
notes: OpenAI-compatible chat completions support streaming and tool calls.
Aion 1.0 and Aion 1.0 Mini are expired and are not counted as current models.
